ticket.title: Preserve the return destination after a password reset
ticket.description: Passengers who begin a password reset from a protected Spaceways page should return to that page after they set a new password.
requirements: Accept an optional returnTo value from the reset request.
Include the return destination in the password-reset link.
Only allow destinations within the Spaceways application.

pr.title: Keep passenger return path in password reset emails
pr.description: Adds return-path support to reset links so passengers can resume their journey after resetting a password.
pr.author: orbit-dev

aiReview.summary: The new returnTo parameter is copied into the reset link without validation. An attacker can use it to create a legitimate-looking Spaceways reset email that sends a passenger to an external site after the reset.

findings.title: Unvalidated return destination enables an open redirect
findings.detail: buildResetLink accepts an arbitrary returnTo value and places it in the reset URL. Restrict it to a relative, application-owned path before including it in the link.

findings.title: Request input reaches the reset email unchanged
findings.detail: The handler forwards the query parameter directly to the link builder, so a URL such as https://attacker.example can be embedded in every requested reset link.
